description: This Figshare dataset maps land cover across Mongolia in 1990, 2000, 2010 and 2020 at 30 m resolution. The research team uses object-oriented interpretation of remote-sensing imagery to distinguish eleven classes, including several steppe types, forest, cropland, water and built areas. The public deposit provides a ZIP under CC-BY-4.0 without a fee; its internal raster encoding remains unverified. These historical maps can support land-use change, infrastructure-exposure and catchment simulations and complement data-esa-worldcover with a longer regional record. Reported overall classification accuracies range from about 82 to 92 percent and differ between years. Apparent changes can therefore include classification error, not real land conversion. The maps do not identify individual buildings or roads, and local applications need class crosswalks and checks against independent observations.
